QuestInfo.name: The New Groove
QuestInfo.0: You still can't tell how Blake's musicianship changed just by listening to his songs. Maestro Rho wants to try something different.
QuestInfo.1: As per Maestro Rho's suggestions, ask Lala how Blake's songs have changed.
QuestInfo.2: Lala says that Blake's latest song sound as if someone pretending to be Blake is singing them. Well, she's a huge fan, so she might be on to something.

0.0: You still don't hear the difference? Well, I suppose you would have to be a fan. Why don't you try that? Ask a fan about Blake's music.

yes.0: Go find Lala. She's been listening to his music since he made his debut, so she's bound to have noticed the change.

no.0: A very small part of his music changed. It's subtle, but it's also what moves people.

1.0: Blake's music? Well... It IS a little different...

yes.0: Blake's music changed a lot since he made his debut. His skills definitely improved...but his passion seems to be gone.
yes.1: I felt like Blake started singing because he wanted to sing, to express himself, but now he only seems to be singing for the paycheck. His songs are becoming more technical and fancier, but the music is missing his heart. I'm sure his other fans will surely get sick of his latest songs soon.

npc.0: Go find Lala. She's been listening to his music since he made his debut, so she's bound to have noticed the change.
